saints.name: Giles
saints.legacy: Patron of the poor and disabled
saints.summary: Saint Giles was a 7th-century hermit known for his deep compassion and miraculous deeds. Born in Athens to a noble family, he dedicated his life to poverty and solitude, performing numerous miracles that drew people to him. His legacy includes the establishment of a monastery in France that became a center of the Benedictine Order.
